# TWOFOLD wiring

<!-- GENERATED by tools/gen_wiring.py from firmware/components/board/include/board_config.h. Do not edit by hand: change the header's
     `/* PIN: signal | module pin | notes */` comments and re-run the script. -->

Board: Waveshare ESP32-S3-Zero. Audio: 48 kHz, MCLK = 256·fs (12.288 MHz) in internal mode, external oscillator 12.288 MHz in low-jitter mode (PLAN.md §4).

## 1. S3-Zero GPIO → modules

| S3-Zero GPIO | signal | connects to (module pin) | dir, internal clock | dir, ext. oscillator | notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| **GPIO1** | OLED SDA | OLED SDA | io (open drain) | io (open drain) | 4.7k pull-up to 3V3 (usually on module) |
| **GPIO2** | OLED SCL | OLED SCL | out (open drain) | out (open drain) | 400 kHz (1 MHz with CONFIG_TWOFOLD_I2C_FAST) |
| **GPIO4** | I2S MCLK | PCM1808 SCKI *(internal mode only)* | out (MCLK 12.288 MHz) | unused: GPIO left as input, not connected | internal clock mode only (256fs = 12.288 MHz) |
| **GPIO5** | I2S BCK | PCM1808 BCK<br>PCM5102A BCK | out (BCK 3.072 MHz) | in (BCK from PCM1808) | output (internal) / input (ext osc) |
| **GPIO6** | I2S LRCK | PCM1808 LRC<br>PCM5102A LCK | out (LRCK 48 kHz) | in (LRCK from PCM1808) | output (internal) / input (ext osc) |
| **GPIO7** | I2S DOUT | PCM5102A DIN | out | out | to DAC |
| **GPIO8** | I2S DIN | PCM1808 DOUT | in | in | from ADC |
| **GPIO9** | DAC XSMT | PCM5102A XSMT | out | out | soft mute, high = play (open the module's XSMT jumper) |
| **GPIO10** | ENC A | EC11 A | in (pull-up) | in (pull-up) | internal pull-up, 10 nF to GND recommended |
| **GPIO11** | ENC B | EC11 B | in (pull-up) | in (pull-up) | internal pull-up, 10 nF to GND recommended; EC11 C -> GND |
| **GPIO12** | ENC SW | EC11 switch | in (pull-up) | in (pull-up) | other switch leg -> GND, internal pull-up |
| **GPIO21** | LED | onboard WS2812 | out (RMT) | out (RMT) | on the S3-Zero PCB, no wiring |

Unused broken-out GPIOs (spare): GPIO13, GPIO14, GPIO15, GPIO16, GPIO17, GPIO18, GPIO38. Avoid strapping pins 0/3/45/46, USB 19/20, UART0 43/44, JTAG 39–42.

## 2. Per-module view

**EC11**

| module pin | S3-Zero | signal |
|---|---|---|

**OLED**

| module pin | S3-Zero | signal |
|---|---|---|

| module pin | S3-Zero | signal |
|---|---|---|
| BCK | GPIO5 | I2S BCK |
| DOUT | GPIO8 | I2S DIN |
| LRC | GPIO6 | I2S LRCK |
| SCKI | GPIO4 | I2S MCLK |

**PCM5102A**

| module pin | S3-Zero | signal |
|---|---|---|

Other module pins: PCM1808 FMT/MD0/MD1 and PCM5102A FLT/DEMP/FMT/SCK are strapped (section 4); EC11 C and the second switch leg go to GND; OLED VCC/GND per section 3.

## 3. Power and ground

| from | to | notes |
|---|---|---|
| S3-Zero **5V** (USB VBUS) | PCM1808 module **+5V** (VCC) | analog supply; the module's LDO makes its 3.3 V. If your module has *no* LDO, feed its 3.3V pin from S3-Zero 3V3 instead |
| S3-Zero **5V** (USB VBUS) | PCM5102A module **VIN** | GY-PCM5102 has its own LDOs (3.3–5 V input); 5 V gives the cleanest AVDD |
| S3-Zero **3V3** | OLED **VCC** | |
| S3-Zero **3V3** | 12.288 MHz oscillator **VDD** and **OE/ST** *(low-jitter mode only)* | 100 nF + 1 µF ceramic right at the oscillator VDD pin |
| S3-Zero **GND** | PCM1808 GND, PCM5102A GND, OLED GND, EC11 C (common) and switch leg, oscillator GND | star ground at the S3-Zero GND pin; keep the audio modules' grounds short and together, run the USB/digital return away from the analog jacks |
| — | PCM1808 module 3.3V pin | leave open when the module regulates its own 3.3 V (do not back-feed the module LDO) |

Logic levels: all I2S/control signals are 3.3 V (ESP32-S3 IO, PCM1808 DVDD = 3.3 V, PCM5102A DVDD = 3.3 V).
Signal integrity: keep MCLK/BCK wires short (< 10 cm) and twisted with a ground wire; a 22–33 Ω series resistor at
the driving end of MCLK and BCK (S3 GPIO4/5 in internal mode) damps ringing on flying leads.

## 4. Converter strapping, both clock modes

| converter pin | internal clock (default) | low-jitter mode (`CONFIG_TWOFOLD_CLOCK_EXT_OSC`) | meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| PCM1808 **FMT** | GND (0) | GND (0) | I2S data format |
| PCM1808 **MD0** | GND (0) | 3V3 (1) | MD1:MD0 = 00: slave; 11: master, SCKI = 256·fs |
| PCM1808 **MD1** | GND (0) | 3V3 (1) | (see MD0) |
| PCM1808 **SCKI** | ← S3 GPIO4 (MCLK 12.288 MHz) | ← oscillator via **33 Ω** | system clock |
| PCM1808 **BCK / LRC** | inputs ← S3 GPIO5 / GPIO6 | **outputs** → S3 GPIO5 / GPIO6 and PCM5102A BCK / LCK | bit / frame clock |
| PCM5102A **FMT** | GND (L) | GND (L) | I2S data format |
| PCM5102A **FLT** | GND (L) | GND (L) | normal-latency FIR filter |
| PCM5102A **DEMP** | GND (L) | GND (L) | de-emphasis off |
| PCM5102A **XSMT** | ← S3 GPIO9 (module XSMT jumper **open**) | ← S3 GPIO9 | soft mute, high = play; firmware holds it low during boot / clock changes |
| PCM5102A **SCK** | **GND** (internal PLL locks to BCK) | ← oscillator via **33 Ω** (PLL bypassed) | system clock |

GY-PCM5102 boards set FLT/DEMP/XSMT/FMT with solder jumpers H1L–H4L on the back: bridge FLT, DEMP and FMT to L,
leave XSMT (H3) **open** and wire the XSMT header pin to GPIO9. Its SCK pad is often bridged to GND on the
front: keep that bridge for the internal mode, remove it for the low-jitter mode.

## 5. Block diagrams

```
INTERNAL CLOCK MODE (default): ESP32-S3 is I2S master, PLL_F160M / (13 + 1/48) -> MCLK

                       +--------------------------------+
   USB-C ==============| Waveshare ESP32-S3-Zero        |
                       |                                |         +-------------------+
                       |  GPIO4  MCLK  12.288 MHz  ---->|-------->| SCKI              |
                       |  GPIO5  BCK    3.072 MHz  ---->|---+---->| BCK    PCM1808    |<== line in L/R
                       |  GPIO6  LRCK      48 kHz  ---->|---|-+-->| LRC    (slave,    |
                       |  GPIO8  DIN               <----|---|-|---| DOUT   MD1:0=00)  |
                       |                                |   | |   +-------------------+
                       |                                |   | |   +-------------------+
                       |                                |   +-|-->| BCK               |
                       |                                |     +-->| LCK   PCM5102A    |==> line out L/R
                       |  GPIO7  DOUT              ---->|-------->| DIN   (SCK = GND, |
                       |  GPIO9  XSMT              ---->|-------->| XSMT   PLL on BCK)|
                       |                                |         +-------------------+
                       |  GPIO1/2  I2C  ---> OLED       |
                       |  GPIO10/11/12  <--- EC11 A/B/SW|
                       +--------------------------------+
```

```
LOW-JITTER MODE (CONFIG_TWOFOLD_CLOCK_EXT_OSC): 12.288 MHz XO, PCM1808 is master, ESP32-S3 + PCM5102A are slaves

     +-------------+   33R    +-------------------+
     | 12.288 MHz  |---/\/\---| SCKI              |
     |  XO (3V3)   |          |      PCM1808      |<== line in L/R
     |             |   33R    |  (master 256fs,   |
     |             |---/\/\-+ |   MD1:0 = 11)     |
     +-------------+        | |  BCK  LRC  DOUT   |
                            | +---+----+-----+----+
                            |     |    |     |
   +------------------------|-----|----|-----|-----+
   | ESP32-S3-Zero          |     |    |     |     |
   |  GPIO5 BCK  (in)  <----|-----+    |     |     |     GPIO4 (MCLK): not connected
   |  GPIO6 LRCK (in)  <----|-----|----+     |     |
   |  GPIO8 DIN        <----|-----|----|-----+     |
   |  GPIO7 DOUT  ----+     |     |    |           |
   |  GPIO9 XSMT -+   |     |     |    |           |
   +--------------|---|-----|-----|----|-----------+
                  |   |     |     |    |
              +---v---v-----v-----v----v----+
              | XSMT DIN   SCK   BCK  LCK   |
              |  PCM5102A (slave,           |==> line out L/R
              |  SCK from XO: no PLL)       |
              +-----------------------------+
```

Low-jitter mode notes: one oscillator output drives two loads through **separate 33 Ω** series resistors placed at the oscillator (star, not daisy-chain). BCK and LRCK come from the PCM1808 and fan out to the ESP32-S3 and the PCM5102A; the firmware configures I2S0 TX+RX as slave. Switching modes = rewire MD0/MD1, SCKI, PCM5102A SCK and rebuild with `CONFIG_TWOFOLD_CLOCK_EXT_OSC`.
